ERR-RNG-001: Damage Bonus Zone exceeds the cap of 600% (Strategy PART 01.2). Truncated for display; raw accumulated value: {raw}%.
ERR-RNG-002: CRIT Rate must be within 0–100% (Strategy PART 01.3). Auto-clamped to {clamped}%.
ERR-RNG-003: CRIT DMG must be within 0–500% (Strategy PART 01.3). Auto-clamped to {clamped}%.
ERR-RNG-004: Defense Zone falls below the observed practical floor of 0.0283 (Strategy PART 01.4). Please check if too many defense reductions + penetrations are stacked.
ERR-RNG-005: Resistance Zone must be within 0–200% (Strategy PART 01.5). Auto-clamped.
ERR-RNG-006: Vulnerability Zone must be within 20%–200% (Strategy PART 01.6); damage reduction cannot stack to invulnerability. Auto-clamped.
ERR-RNG-007: Daze Vulnerability Zone (when dazed) must be within 20%–500% (Strategy PART 01.7). Auto-clamped.
ERR-RNG-008: Sheer Damage Bonus Zone must be within 20%–900% (Strategy PART 01.8). Auto-clamped.
ERR-RNG-009: Anomaly Proficiency hit cap of 1000 (Anomaly Proficiency Zone = Anomaly Proficiency / 100, PART 03.3.1 cap is [0, 10]). Auto-clamped.
ERR-DAT-001: Skill segment ratio is not yet in the agent's skill library. Used placeholder ratio 100%; please fill in the correct value.
ERR-DAT-002: Enemy's L1 base defense is not in the built-in data. Used the average for this tier; you may override manually.
ERR-DAT-003: ⚠ Sheer Force conversion coefficients for Rupture-specialty agent {agentId} are not yet confirmed. Only Yixuan (attack ×0.3 + HP ×0.1) has official data; please configure manually in expert mode or switch to a non-Rupture agent.
ERR-DAT-004: This enemy has incomplete source fields; some parameters are inferred. See ⓘ for details.
ERR-SRC-001: ⚠ Modifier at {path} has no source. Core treated it as a user/temporary contributor (sourceMissing=true + diagnosticRefs). For formal data, please check the data package source.
ERR-VER-001: Imported build uses ruleSet={originalRuleSetVersion}, compatible with current {currentRuleSetVersion}. Auto-recomputed; original version info preserved in original* metadata.
ERR-VER-002: Imported build uses ruleSet={originalRuleSetVersion} (incompatible with current {currentRuleSetVersion}). Please choose: [Recompute with current rules] / [Keep original (read-only)]
ERR-VER-003: Currently displaying original version data (ruleSet={originalRuleSetVersion} / data={originalDataVersion} / source={originalSourceVersion} / game={originalGameVersion}). All inputs are read-only. To edit, recompute or create a new build.
ERR-VER-004: Exiting read-only mode will recompute with current rules and generate new results. Original version fields (originalGameVersion / originalRuleSetVersion / originalDataVersion / originalSourceVersion) will be preserved as metadata. schemaVersion takes current. Continue?
ERR-EVENT-001: Manual event {eventId} is missing baseValue (e.g., enemy.maxHp). Cannot compute true damage.
ERR-EVENT-002: Corrupted Shield Cleanse event has no rule version specified. Available: default-15pct / pre-2.2-3pct / post-2.2-2.5pct.
ERR-EVENT-003: Part-break event {eventId} references partId {partId} not found in enemy {enemyId} data.
ERR-EVENT-004: Manual event {eventId} kind {kind} is unknown. Recognized kinds: partBreak / corruptedShieldCleanse.
ERR-UI-001: This attack deals no damage in this scenario. Possible causes: Resistance Zone is 0, damage reduction floored at 20%, or hit on a non-weakness attribute.
ERR-UI-003: Team contains unsupported field (e.g., subordinate / Bangboo). V1 does not support this feature; the corresponding field has been ignored.
ERR-OCR-000: This tool does not parse screenshots. Screenshots are visual references only. Please fill in fields manually.
ERR-CALC-PENDING-ANOMALY: ⚠ V1 PR #10 stage: anomaly damage formula returns a schema-compatible skeleton only and does **not produce trustworthy values**. Full anomaly computation (virtual agent weighting / anomaly trigger count table / anomaly crit zone / overflow exclusion, etc.) is implemented by task #27 [TL-S3-4].
ERR-CALC-PENDING-DISORDER: ⚠ V1 PR #10 stage: disorder damage formula returns a schema-compatible skeleton only and does **not produce trustworthy values**. Full disorder computation (seven-attribute multipliers / daze level zone / disorder daze accumulation / disorderFormulaId trace evidence, etc.) is implemented by task #27 [TL-S3-4].
ERR-CLI-ARG: Command argument error: {message}. Run `fairy help <command>` for usage.
ERR-CLI-CMD: Unknown subcommand: {command}. Available: calc / compare / scan / explain / migrate / help.
ERR-CLI-JSON: Failed to parse input JSON: {input}. Check the file format or run `fairy explain` for an example.
ERR-CLI-SCHEMA: Input does not match BattleSnapshot schema. See JSON `error.details` for specifics; refer to docs/data-contract/battle-snapshot.md.
ERR-CLI-UNCAUGHT: Uncaught error: {message}. Please file an issue with the input and command.
ERR-CMP-001: Compare inputs differ on {field}: left={left}, right={right}. The numeric delta is still computed, but this is an apples-to-oranges comparison.
ERR-DAT-005: ⚠ Blocking unparsed effect detected in cleaned data (reason: {reason}, effectId: {effectId}). Source text: "{sourceText}". This effect affects calculation / matching / source traceability and must be resolved by manual audit + handler/template registration or data update before release. See docs/data-contract/cleaned-schema-spec.md §6.5.
ERR-DAT-006: ⚠ Locale mapping unresolved for {language} (path: {path}). The data package could not establish a stable zh/en mapping across sources (Mihoyo / Excel / buhflipexplode); display falls back to source text. Please add the mapping in the next data audit cycle.
